mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business_trip_detail ( approval_id, trip_type, destination, start_dt, end_dt, reason ) VALUES ( #{approvalId}, #{tripType}, #{destination}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{reason} )
mapper.select: SELECT trip_type AS tripType, destination AS destination, start_dt AS startDate, end_dt AS endDate, reason AS reason FROM business_trip_detail WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId}
